summary: EVPN and PBB-EVPN offer multihoming through Ethernet Segments in Single-Active or All-Active modes. This RFC introduces Virtual Ethernet Segments, extending those capabilities to cases where the attachment to the customer is not a plain physical link.

eli5.summary: A kid can plug into two outlets for backup. This lets a connection that is not a plain wire still get that kind of backup protection.
